better-sg-reports.js.description: This script creates a comprehensive, branded dashboard on SiteGround hosting accounts to analyze CPU, memory, and request data across sites. It helps users understand server load, site performance, and the effectiveness of fixes through interactive charts, comparisons, and detailed reports.
usage: Open the SiteGround account's dashboard or statistics pages where the data can be intercepted.
Run the script in the browser console on a page showing SiteGround API responses or relevant statistics.
Wait until the dashboard UI appears, then use the provided tabs and controls to explore metrics, generate reports, or export data.
Ensure the necessary API responses are captured; the script intercepts fetch calls to gather data. It relies on specific SiteGround endpoints for accurate info.
For best results, wait 5–7 days after deploying a fix before analyzing results to avoid skewed data from partial days.

ie-extractor.js.description: This script creates a floating image extractor panel on any page, which collects all images, detects if they are from iStock, and displays them in a sortable table. You can filter images by filename, alt text, or iStock ID, select images, and download their files directly. It enhances image management without altering page content permanently.
usage: Run the bookmarklet while on a page with images to activate the extractor panel.
Click the 🖼 Images FAB button to show/hide the panel.
Use the search box or filters to find specific images by filename, alt, or iStock ID.
Click download options in the panel to save selected images.
